notes.title: The big QOL-update!
notes.notes:
We're finally ready with a new update!

Our primary goal with this update was the inclusion of remappable controls. This proved to be a monumental task, since user input touches basically every aspect of the game.

To avoid our work days becoming too monotonous, we've snuck in some extra quality of life-features that were much more fun to make!

[b]Here are the new QOL-features included in SNØ 1.0.02.22[/b]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] ⌨️ Rebindable gameplay controls
[*] 📸 Rebindable photo mode controls
[*] 🎮 Platform responsive controller glyphs
[*] 🪂 Dynamic transparency glider
[*] 📝 Saved mountain notes
[*] 🌄 Saved mountain vibe preview
[*] 🎨 Glider material preview on start screen
[*] 🗼 Cairns are now color coded to indicate progression down the mountain
[*] 👕 UI element indicating number of collected outfits, and the one currently selected
[*] 🎽 Fast iteration through outfits by using mouse wheel or holding down shoulder button
[*] 💻 V-Sync settings
[*] 🎞️ FPS limiter settings
[/list]
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] 🏗️ New layout on the combined controller overview/remapping screen
[*] ⚙️ New design and layout on some UI elements in the settings menu
[*] 🎮 The gamepad controller overview will not fade in if controls have been remapped
[*] ⌨️ Improved on screen keyboard interaction. Should now accept input from keyboard, gamepad and mouse clicks interchangeably 
[*] #️⃣ Mountain generator now also accepts numerical seeds written with a leading "#"
[*] ⏸️ Photo mode is now also labeled as pause in the new controls overview/remapping screen
[*] 📖 Updated some Chinese translations (thank you @sai259752)
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] ⌨️ Fixed bug that caused user to sometimes select UI-elements behind the on screen keyboard
[*] 🔊 Audio levels now resets when restoring settings
[*] 🍬 Smørbukk easter egg no longer visible during first person gameplay
[*] 🔠 Missing letters and UI bug on Mac should be fixed (not verified)
[/list]
[b]Achievements[/b]
[list]
[*] 🧘 No additional achievements
[*] 🔒 Achievement gold lock - Henceforth, we will add no new achievements to the base game of SNØ. Happy hunting!
[/list]

We hope the new features will help make SNØ more accessible and enjoyable to even more people!

Please let us know if you think any of the new features will improve [b][i]YOUR[/i][/b] quality of life, either here in the comments or on our [url=https://discord.gg/te8zF4rcS2]Discord[/url]! 😀

Best
Alex
SG

notes.title: THE SNOWBOARD UPDATE 🏂
notes.notes:
[b]The snowboarder is finally ready[/b] 🏂 - our most requested feature in SNØ by far! It took a lot of work to get right, but I think we got there in the end! Also...

[b]✨ SNØ is on SALE! ✨[/b]

SNØ is part of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nomorerobotssport-acularfestival]Sport-acular Festival[/url] and discounted by [b]30 %[/b] until Wed, Apr 16, 10 AM PDT (7 PM GMT+2)


[b]About the new snowboarder[/b]
The snowboarder plays very similar to the skiers - same stats, same scoring logic, mostly same everything. But due to the nature of a snowboarder, it does come with a couple of unique quirks that sets them apart from the skiers:
[olist]
[*] 🧭 No "backwards" - Instead of riding switch like a skier, a snowboarder will just turn their head and keep on riding facing forwards. We had to rewrite our procedural posing components to account for this new, bidirectional behavior.
[*] 🤠 Helmet - We quickly noticed that a snowboarder carries around significantly less gear than a skier. To compensate we decided to give the snowboarder a helmet! Not only does it balance the color composition, it can also fly off during a crash! (No, it will not save you 🤕)
[*] 🔦 Bidirectional headlight - The snowboarder will always face in the direction of travel, and therefore their headlight will too during pitch black nights.
[*] 🦘 Bidirectional unstuck jump direction - When riding at very slow velocities the jump is angled slightly forwards to help you gain some speed. The skiers have a defined forward facing direction, while the snowboarder's forward is defined by the current travel direction.
[*] ↔️ Goofy/Regular - Someone made us aware that stance could be a sensitive topic! But we had to choose one, and we chose goofy (right foot in front), simply because it looks best in the main menu. But we acknowledge both riding stances, and so we threw in an extra achievement in honor of all you regulars out there 🤙 
[/olist]
Here are some other things that are new in SNØ 1.0.01.83

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] 🏂 Snowboarder - New playable character!
[*] 🌨️ New weather type - Some mountains now feature heavy snowfall, without going full snowstorm
[*] 🎿 Leaderboard rider icon - The leaderboard now indicate the rider used to achieve a score
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] ✒️ Calligraphic snow deformation - Skis/boards now deform snow like flat tipped pens
[*] 💥 Improved grind effect - Grind sparks light up the environment
[/list]
[b]Fix[/b][u]e[/u][b]s:[/b]
[list]
[*] 📸 Photo mode bug - Game should no longer crash on some Mac devices when taking a photo
[/list]
If you have any feedback on the new snowboarder, suggestions or other thoughts, please let us know in our [url=https://discord.gg/te8zF4rcS2]Discord[/url]! 😄

See you in the mountains! ⛷️❤️🏂

Best
Alex
SG

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
As a part of our major optimization update we did a lot of under the hood changes. I rewrote and shuffled around on some of the game's core logic for managing terrain chunks and spawning of obstacles. After doing some internal testing, we discovered that the game performed worse than before under certain circumstances. After making such a big deal about the performance update we really felt that we had to address these issues.

Here is the stuff that is fixed in version 0.1.16.24

🛠️ [b]Fixes[/b] 🛠️
[list]
[*] Balanced the timing of spawning in new obstacles to avoid frame drops
[*] Fixed bug that caused all despawn operations to happen instantly instead of being timed. This contributed to frame drops.
[*] Removed an end of demo biome that could cause game to crash.
[/list]
😜 [b]Known issues[/b] 😜
[list]
[*] Chasing a rabbit through certain forests/terrain can still cause frame drops.
[*] Some of the end of demo biomes feature unoptimized obstacles and can cause frame drops.
[/list]

Best
Alex
SG

notes.title: 1.14.17 - Next Fest Update
notes.notes:
Next Fest is really close, and here are a couple of fun new things you can expect from our demo during Next Fest!

[b]🌟 New features 🌟[/b]
[list]
[*] Limited seasonal skins - Through Next Fest, the procedural skin generator will feature exclusive colors and skin patterns (connection to Steam required)
[*] Death reason - The game tells you why you died on the game over screen
[*] Delete skins - Got a skin you didn't like? Delete it to unclutter your wardrobe. 
[*] Steam Cloud Saves - Saved mountains and unlocked skins should now be available across all your devices
[/list]
[b]🔁 Changes 🔁[/b]
[list]
[*] End of run combo cash in - After demo timer runs out, land safely in the snow to cash in any ongoing combos. In earlier versions of the demo, time out automatically broke your combo.
[*] Longer demo ride distance - From 750 to 1000 meters.
[*] Multiplier deceleration - The score multiplier now grows slower over time
[*] Made the collider mesh inside tree canopies visible to help with gameplay readability.
[*] Reduced clutter in options menu by removing some unnecessary settings.
[/list]
[b]🛠️ Fixes 🛠️[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where the performing tricks in succession could generate insane amounts of points
[*] Visual tweaks to leaderboard to make it not bleed outside the screen
[*] Performance optimizations
[*] Various tweaks and fixes
[/list]
[b]😜 Known issues 😜[/b]
[list]
[*] Demo controls overview claim tricks are not available, and that action cam is available. It's the other way around.
[*] Still some performance issues and lag spikes on low to mid range hardware
[/list]
These changes are based on three weeks of experience seeing all of you play our demo and all your amazing feedback here on Steam and on our Discord. Most of these changes will also apply to the final game!

Enjoy the new demo, and enjoy Next Fest!

Best
Alex
SG
